mentions.name: Claude-profiles
mentions.description: This tool provides an easy way to back up and switch between Claude Code profiles by managing the ~/.claude directory.
mentions.problem: There is no easy way to back up and switch between Claude Code profiles (the ~/.claude directory).
mentions.audience: Users of Claude Code, i.e., developers working with the ~/.claude directory
mentions.source_excerpt:
Claude-profiles https://github.com/alimoeeny/claude-profiles
an easy way to backup and switch your claude-code profile (the ~/.claude directory)
